title: Planning-horizon and beam-width sweep of MPC-RH

quantities.selection_effect_nats: nested cross-fitted D_select paired loss of the MPC-RH configuration minus the reconstructed comparator q_C (select/decision.json mean of the configuration's candidate; nats)
quantities.expected_serial_cost: deployed sparse/dense multiply-add work of the configuration on D_select normalized by one nominal E = 1 execution (select/candidates.json cost; nominal executions); equal to the expected cost because the released runner has no serving-time input gate
quantities.oracle_headroom_bound_nats: U(Delta_oracle) of the registered configuration: upper limit of the training-only D_explore oracle headroom (select/entry_complete.json headroom upper of the parent run; nats)
quantities.realized_fraction: selection_effect_nats divided by oracle_headroom_bound_nats (fraction of the headroom bound realized; main Proposition 4)

configuration: MPC-RH at the profile and ensemble size of the parent run's deployed MPC-RH rule; the horizon sweep holds the registered beam width, the beam sweep holds the registered horizon
notes: Produced by `python -B scripts/run_sweep.py plan --sweep horizon_beam_sweep --parent <sealed PascalVOC-SP run> --output <sweep>`, `run_sweep.py run --plan <sweep>/plan.json --data-root <datasets> --device cuda` (one lifecycle run per configuration outside the parent's registered horizons and beam width: run_cross_morse.py --config <variant> --stage prepare..select --resume), `run_sweep.py collect --plan <sweep>/plan.json`, then `python -B scripts/export_sweep_records.py --results <sweep>/results.json --hardware ... --period ...`. Configurations inside the parent's registry (horizons of controller.horizons at controller.beam_width) are read from the parent run itself; the others come from variant lifecycle runs whose configuration differs from the parent only in controller.horizons or controller.beam_width. The headroom denominator is the parent's for every row.
